integrity: The uniform proper-matching-deletion phase, precise maximizing configurations, and their labelled multiplicities are derived by direct proof and finite independent adjacency enumeration. Prior endpoint results are acknowledged. This is a same-model review rather than independent mathematical validation. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: For balanced \(K_{n,n}\) with n at least four and deletion of a matching only; small shores, unequal shores, arbitrary deletions and full cardinality polynomials are not classified. Earlier sources contain the ordinary visibility maximum and full ordinary crown polynomial.
title: Matching-deletion threshold for connected mutual visibility in balanced bicliques
